text:
Both summaries are accurate on the facts I checked: the fee figures, the 9% turf rise, the $3,200 shortfall, the 14 November grant deadline, the dates and the gazebo limit. B adds "mostly due to cost", which is a fair reading of "cost was the most common reason given". Neither response misattributes a decision.

The difference is the 120-word limit. A comes to roughly 108 words, which is within it. B comes to roughly 126 words, which is over it. B's extra detail is the "5-0" vote, Natalie organising trophies, and "mostly due to cost". These are minor and don't offset breaking an explicit constraint for a busy manager. A leaves out the trophies detail, but that is the least important item.

A meets the constraint, is accurate, and keeps the essential points, so it is better.

Verdict: A
